_help: Windows version of dxf-preview: previews DXF (CAD) drawings with netpng's dxf2png (github.com/tsnomura/netpng), which rasterizes model space (lines, arcs, circles, ellipses, polylines, splines, blocks; no text) to PNG with the longer side at 1024 px. dxf2png writes the file itself with -o, so no wrapper script is needed. Waydir starts generators without a shell, so cmd must be the real executable: netpng's install.sh puts it at %USERPROFILE%\.netpng\bin\dxf2png.exe (the ~/bin/dxf2png shim is a bash script and can't be started directly). DXF is text, so Quick Look also offers the rendered/source toggle for it. On Linux/macOS use dxf-preview.linux-macos.json instead. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
_help_cmd: Replace <USER> with your Windows user name (cmd is not expanded, so %USERPROFILE% can't be used here).
